svg.title: Drawdown | CPPI vs Buy & Hold | S&P 500 | 2018–2025
svg.desc: Daily drawdown, 100 times (wealth / running peak - 1), from 2017-12-29 through 2025-12-31. Maximum drawdown: Buy & Hold 33.92%; CPPI 8.66%. Each portfolio has its own peak, including initial wealth 100. Peaks do not reset each year. Negative values show loss below the peak; zero means at a running high. 2012 observations.
svg.metadata: Source: S&P Dow Jones Indices via FRED SP500, retrieved 2026-09-19. Derived educational calculation. Calendar-date x axis; linear drawdown y axis -40% to 0%, common to all four charts. No smoothing or resampling. Annual rules and limitations: portfolio-insurance.html#sp500-test.
